cells.Read by: `rinzler`, `runtron`, the packaged systemd unit, `bin/fuse_cleanup.py` (`src/system/fuse_helpers.cpp`, `packaging/systemd/rinzler@.service` and other files)
cells.Values and default: Directory path, used as given. The program creates a missing directory. A failed creation logs the warning `Could not create FUSE mount point`. When the mount then fails, `runtron` exits with status 1 and `rinzler` aborts. Unset: `/opt/positron/stats`. A program under `gen/` uses `<repository root>/stats` (see `REPO_ROOT_OVERRIDE`).
cells.Effect: Sets the base directory of the FUSE stats mount. When the instance count is above 1, the program appends `/instance-<id>`. `RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PRESCOPED=1` turns this suffix off. `--fuse-mount` overrides it and is used as given. `rinzler_proxy` never mounts and ignores it. The packaged systemd unit sets `/var/run/rinzler/<N>`. The unit does not start with a relative path, `/`, or a path directly under `/`. Check: the log line `Stats/config mounted at <path>`.

evidence: src/system/fuse_helpers.cpp:25 - `getenv("RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH")`; a non-empty value is used as given and logged with `FUSE mount point from RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH: {}`
src/system/fuse_helpers.cpp:30 - unset or empty: `<repository root>/stats` for a program with `/gen/` in its path, else `/opt/positron/stats`

src/system/fuse_helpers.cpp:99 - `ensure_mountpoint` creates the directory; a failure only logs `Could not create FUSE mount point {}: {}`

src/rinzler.cpp:4725 - `--fuse-mount` is used as given and skips `default_mountpoint`

packaging/systemd/rinzler@.service:48 - the unit runs `rinzler-descriptor` before the start

unresolved: TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE - whether the output of the abort holds the text `Failed to load Harmony encoding`. The code path says no: the `harmony_error` is not caught, and the terminate handler logs only backtrace lines (src/common/backtrace.cpp:33). t/proxy/README.md:457 says that the proxy fails with that text. One start of `rinzler_proxy` with a gpt-oss model and `TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE=/nonexistent` settles it.

TRON_TOKENIZE_PY - what the process does when the program exists but exits with an error. `make_python_tokenizer` logs `Failed to create fallback python tokenizer` and returns a tokenizer without a handle (src/rinzler/tokenizers.cpp:1927). `tokenizer::encode` then uses the handle without a test (src/rinzler/tokenizers.cpp:310). One run with `TRON_TOKENIZE_PY=/bin/false USE_PYTHON_TOKENIZER=1` shows the result. The row does not state this case.

TRON_LOG_DIR - where a production instance writes `alderaan.log`. The packaged unit does not set the variable, and its working directory is `/opt/positron`. The tron-host drop-in says that the `positron` user cannot write there (packaging/tron-host/90-rinzler-host.conf:9). Whether platformd sets `TRON_LOG_DIR` is not in this repository. One read of `/etc/rinzler/instance-<N>.env` on a deployed host settles it.

RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH - the row says that `rinzler` aborts when the mount fails. This comes from the code path (src/rinzler.cpp:4988 is outside the try block). No run confirmed it. One start of `rinzler` with `RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH` under a directory that the user cannot write settles it.
label_doubts: SPDLOG_LEVEL - Operators - the packaged unit does not set it, and no Tron document describes it for deployed systems. The only other mention is a debugging tip in a developer document. The variable can only hide messages, and `TRON_LOG_LEVEL` does the same. - README.tokenizers.md:242
notes: Sources outside the checkout. The `openai-harmony` facts come from the cargo checkout of the locked commit ec7606df (tag v0.0.8, the commit in rust/harmony/Cargo.lock). The spdlog facts come from a v1.17.0 source tree in another build directory (the version in cmake/versions.cmake). The checkout is not clean: `git status` shows staged changes to AGENTS.md, README.md and README.environment.md. I read only source files, and I changed nothing. Row length forced cuts in TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE, TRON_TOKENIZE_PY and RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH. Cut facts: the meaning of the execution slug, the second FUSE log line `FUSE mount point from RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH: <path>`, the sentence that an empty RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH counts as unset, and the purpose of the tokenizer child process. Other places that need a change, outside these rows. (1) `TIKTOKEN_RS_CACHE_DIR` is named in the TIKTOKEN_ENCODINGS_BASE row and has no row of its own; the document says that each variable appears one time. (2) README.tokenizers.md:45 says that a failed Rust tokenizer falls back to the Python tokenizer, and line 49 names `USE_RUST_TOKENIZER=false`; the code has no such fallback and reads `USE_PYTHON_TOKENIZER`. (3) README.tokenizers.md:242 advises `SPDLOG_LEVEL=debug` for more detail; that value cannot show more than the default level. "Check:" is used where a log line shows the value or the tokenizer that is used (TRON_TOKENIZE_PY, USE_PYTHON_TOKENIZER, VALIDATE_TOKENIZERS, RZ_FUSE_MOUNT_PATH). The four rows whose whole effect is a log line (TRON_LATCH_WATCHDOG, TRON_LOG_KV_GRANULARITY, TRON_LOG_PLACEMENT, TRON_PERF_INTERVAL_SEC) keep the line in the first sentences and have no "Check:".
